hazard: The heater stays on until the room overheats
detection: temperature above the hard limit for more than 30 s, or heater commanded on for longer than its maximum on-time
response: open the heater relay, latch the fault until a person clears it, and sound the local buzzer
test: bench: short the relay driver on; the watchdog path must open the relay within 30 s

hazard: A sensor fails and the controller keeps acting on its last value
detection: no valid reading for 3 consecutive periods, a CRC error, or a value outside the physical range
response: switch every actuator to its safe state and raise an error alarm
test: unplug the sensor while the heater is on; the heater must be off within 3 periods

hazard: The farmer believes the system is fine while it has been silent for an hour
detection: cloud side: no status write from the device for 10 min
response: mark the device offline in the app and send a push notification
test: pull the power at the device; the app must show 'offline' within 10 min

hazard: A reboot after a power cut turns an actuator on before any reading exists
detection: boot sequence itself, plus pull-down resistors on every relay driver pin so the relay board's default state at reset is off whatever the firmware does
response: drive every actuator to its safe state before initialising sensors or the network
test: power-cycle 20 times with a logic analyser on the relay pins; no pin may go active before the first valid reading

hazard: A setting typed in the app is applied without limits
detection: setting outside the allowed range or changing faster than the allowed rate
response: clamp the setting on the device and report the clamped value back
test: write target=90 to the cloud; the device must report target=the maximum and never heat beyond it

hazard: Readings are lost during a network outage
response: buffer readings locally and replay them in order after reconnecting
test: block the broker for 2 h; after unblocking, the history must contain every reading with its original timestamp

hazard: Anyone on the internet can change a device's settings
